requirement_vague: Getting user by ID should reject invalid UUID format. Test with 'not-a-uuid' string. Admin credentials: admin@example.com / password123
requirement_precise: Login as superuser (admin@example.com / password123) to get token. Attempt to GET /api/v1/users/not-a-uuid (invalid UUID format). Verify the response status is 422 (validation error).

implementation.location: POST /api/v1/login/access-token and GET /api/v1/users/{user_id} in login_access_token and read_user_by_id
implementation.reasoning: The user ID path parameter is typed as UUID, so FastAPI/Pydantic automatically validates the format and rejects values like 'not-a-uuid' with HTTP 422 before entering the handler. The login endpoint exists and authenticates the configured superuser credentials admin@example.com / password123 to obtain a bearer token for the request.
